key_insight: A SCAPS-1D + machine learning workflow can rapidly rank multilayer perovskite solar-cell stacks and pinpoint the layer properties that most strongly drive efficiency.
engineering_relevance: The study provides a practical screening strategy for choosing ETL/absorber/HTL combinations, enabling faster design of high-efficiency and lead-free perovskite solar cells.
method: Trained an ML model on a representative subset to predict PCE for unseen stacks.
Used SHAP to identify the most influential descriptors and verify top candidates with full device simulations.
evidence_signal: Leave-One-Group-Out cross-validation showed strong ranking performance, and the model’s top predictions were confirmed by SCAPS-1D, including devices reaching 28.85% and 28.62% PCE.
watch_item: The model’s reliability depends on the representativeness of the simulated design space, so transfer to new materials or fabrication conditions may require retraining or additional validation.
paper_title: Multilayer Screening of Double and Conventional Perovskite Solar Cells Using SCAPS-1D and Machine Learning: Optimization of ETL, HTL, and Absorber for High-Efficiency Architectures
